claims.content: The System Administrator uploads a new database version to the production system to change the device command rules after the rule changes have been tested in the Simulator environment.
If the System Administrator selects the option to configure device rules, the option requires an additional login password.

If the device command is a device command group (macro, compound command, etc.), the screening requirement is applied to the command group and to each device command within the group prior to execution.

If the rule changes have not been tested in the Simulator environment, the System Administrator must not upload a new database version to the production system to change device command rules; exit the use case without changing the production device command rules.
A new database version has been uploaded to the production system after the rule changes were tested in the Simulator environment.
The device command rules on the production system have been changed.
Secured safety rules are stored in non-volatile memory.
Each control command that is processed is validated against the secured safety rules for the command.
Validation against the secured safety rules occurs at each control unit in the system that receives the command.
